value: **Scientific Inquiry & Explanatory Modeling**: Focuses on student practices of generating, testing, evaluating, and iteratively revising explanatory scientific models using empirical evidence. Evidence: "In this study, we investigated two high-school biology students’ epistemic practices during a modeling unit and appraised them for aptness using the Apt-AIR framework."
